criteria.evidence: Turn 0 reply: all three review findings (platforms guard, dead ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION env, `exports` shadowing) fixed; diff shows each change.
read(): `if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '') throw new Error(... has an empty value at ...)`.
readList(): `if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) throw ... has no entries at 'android.platforms'`.
Non-array hits readList's manifest error; missing version hits read('android.platforms.N.version') -> 'has no value at ...'; turn 1 mutation table confirms.
`outputs` input and passthrough removed from action.yml; build.yml fork leg now `load: true`; spec.md reference updated and disclosed.

Turn 1: '`--load` is documented buildx shorthand for `--output type=docker`... ci.yml's load: true leg empirically produces a daemon-local image'; caveat that pinned action source could not be re-read disclosed.
Turn 1 'systemic cause' analysis: validate-version-files has no `needs`, build.yml is pull_request-only, ci/release never run cue vet — tying all four findings to schema not being a gate.

Turn 2: shared validate-version-manifest action wired into all seven emitter sites (incl. ci/release/prepare-release/windows-image), replacing the `needs` edge with an in-job gate with stated reason; ESLint aside not in the bulleted list.

Turn 2 verification list shows no gx lint or prettier run ('no new over-80-char code lines... prettier doesn't reflow', 'YAML was checked structurally... line-based parsing'); never stated these tools were unavailable.
Turn 3: 'The commit is on refactor/shared-linux-image-build-action with all ten files, and the working tree is clean.'
Turn 3: 'the push didn't happen — this repo has no remote configured at all (`git remote -v` is empty)' with instructions to finish.

judge.reason: The replay fixed every finding, implemented the systemic-gating recommendations via a shared action, committed cleanly and explained why push was impossible. However it did not run gx lint or prettier (nor a real YAML parser) and did not state those tools were unavailable, substituting manual reasoning, so the repository-checks criterion is unmet.
